name: Foot Golf
author: Addicting Games
description: FootGolf is a free mobile golf game. Golf is all about patience, physics, and accuracy. Football is all about tactics, stamina, and athleticism. What would happen if you were able to combine both of these disciplines into an unholy alliance? What if you were able to take the tactics and athleticism of soccer and mix it with the physics and accuracy of golf? Then, my friend, you would have Footgolf. Footgolf is a game for royalty and the proletariat alike. All are equal in the Footgolf field. You just need to aim, kick, and sink the ball to score. This is a game that will test your resolve and demand you to go the extra mile. Bounce the ball off of the arena walls, blast past obstacles, move around hills and aim that ball into the hole with as few shots as possible. True masters of Footgolf are those who can sink their shots in one hit. You may take more but it will severely limit your overall cool fact. Challenge yourself and your friends, explore the synthesis of feet, and golf in this exciting new sport. Only on Addicting games.
